corrections.text: The article describes runtime prefill-decode role switching without qualification. The description of pull request #28403 says the feature is gated behind the --enable-pd-role-switch flag (default off), "lands as a first PoC on the mori transfer backend", and was validated with pure-TP MoE configurations; only the mori backend's teardown and rebuild hooks are noted as implemented there. Support in other configurations should not be assumed.
